required_fields: Clinical phenotypes reported in affected individuals with exact numerator and denominator counts per cohort, original paper wording, standard HPO terms, and resolvable citations (PMID or DOI)
Most discriminating findings that distinguish this condition from overlapping disorders, naming the confused disorders and evaluating confidence in the distinction
Findings explicitly evaluated and found absent in affected individuals that argue against the diagnosis if present
Phenotypic variations or differences stratified by variant type, variant position, age, or sex
Phenotypic findings or observations that one study reports and another explicitly contradicts
